- **self**: Momentum versus mean reversion evidence in crypto (3/2)

## Definitions

- [statement] Headline gross returns from crypto signal studies are not evidence of tradable edge: both independent tests found the reversal signal profitable before costs and unprofitable after realistic fees given high turnover, so any citation of a gross Sharpe or gross return without a cost model should be discounted. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prams2104/crypto-momentum-backtest/main/README.md · keywords: Momentum versus mean reversion evidence in crypto · also: https://financialnoob.substack.com/p/momentum-vs-mean-reversion-in-crypto

## How it works

- [statement] Caporale and Plastun test BTC, LTC, XRP and DASH after price overreactions: the next-day move is larger in both directions, but a counter-movement (reversal) strategy was unprofitable and an inertia (momentum) strategy was profitable on paper yet statistically indistinguishable from random. The authors conclude the overreactions are not exploitable, possibly because of transaction costs. (low confidence) — https://ideas.repec.org/p/ces/ceswps/_6861.html · keywords: Momentum versus mean reversion evidence in crypto

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Wen, Bouri, Xu and Zhao (North American Journal of Economics and Finance 2022; Bitcoin high-frequency data, 3 Mar 2013 to 31 May 2020) report both intraday momentum and intraday reversal in Bitcoin, with the patterns shifting around large price jumps, FOMC announcements, liquidity levels and the COVID-19 outbreak. The effect also appears in Ethereum, Litecoin and Ripple. They tie momentum to late-informed investors and the reversal, which they call unique to crypto, to overreaction and overconfidence. A timing strategy built on the predictors beats always-long and buy-and-hold in economic value; Mroziewicz and Slepaczuk's literature review says this was without costs. (medium confidence) — https://ideas.repec.org/a/eee/ecofin/v62y2022ics1062940822000833.html · keywords: Momentum versus mean reversion evidence in crypto · also: https://arxiv.org/html/2602.10785v1
